correctness.rationale: The low indices are explicit positive discrete Laplace transforms. For every index at least 3, reciprocal simple negative Eulerian zeros force a genuine pole in the open right half-plane, contradicting the holomorphy required by the Hausdorff–Bernstein–Widder representation. Non-cancellation follows from the Eulerian differential recurrence.

originality.rationale: Wei–Guo (2014) proves decreasing monotonicity and poses complete monotonicity of all ratio indices as Conjecture 12. Searches of the exact conjecture, derivative-ratio, negative-integer polylogarithm, and Eulerian-rational formulations did not locate the exact index classification or pole obstruction. Equivalent coverage under different notation remains a documented residual risk.

value.rationale: The result completely settles a concrete published conjecture, identifies the exact threshold including the nontrivial positive index 2, and gives a structural obstruction that applies uniformly to every larger index.

limitations: The theorem concerns the specific consecutive derivative ratios of Wei–Guo (2014), not arbitrary polylogarithm ratios.
Eulerian real-rootedness, reciprocity, and the Hausdorff–Bernstein–Widder theorem are classical ingredients.
Equivalent prior coverage under different polylogarithm or Eulerian notation cannot be excluded.
